name: factor
wording: one independent lever of an agent, which no other factor's value determines: identity (role, objective, expertise, procedure, stance, communication-style), authority (decision-rights, autonomy), reach (perception-scope, action-scope, handoffs), cognition (model, memory), interface (assignment, deliverable), and governance (guardrails, enforcement-level, evaluation); deployment choices such as the harness or how a session starts are not factors.
reason: The central naming batch of 2026-10-10 kept procedure, stance, communication-style, perception-scope, action-scope, handoffs, assignment, deliverable and enforcement-level as the best-fit signs.
